analysis:
Reviewed all three primary analyses and the supplied source replay against the canonical index and selected TB-002/TB-011 definitions. Independently examined documentation patches, the full reconnect-policy test patch, mock close-helper changes and file metadata. No supported security regression was identified in this documentation/test scope; this does not establish runtime safety.
Documentation describes resetting backoff after a 60-second registered session and a randomized 0–1-second reconnect after coordinator close code 1012 (changelog.d/provider-fast-reconnect.md:3–5; docs/architecture/components/provider.md:119–143). CoordinatorReconnectPolicyTests.swift:32–93 verifies reset thresholds, repeated 1012 closes without growth, and ordinary exponential delays for other closes and failed attempts. MockCoordinator.swift:447–456 parameterizes test close frames while retaining lock-protected writer removal and the default 1001 close. These changes do not themselves alter serving permission, encryption, billing, cache isolation or privileged authority. The trusted coordinator's restart hint alone is not evidence of an adversarial authorization bypass.
Material uncertainty remains: production CoordinatorReconnectPolicy.swift, CoordinatorClientState.swift and CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift are absent. Review must verify socket-specific close-code capture and callback ordering, cancellation-aware waits, ordinary failure backoff, and teardown before replacement. Under TB-002/TB-011 and T-053, accelerated registration must preserve fresh socket nonces, origin-bound Apple replies, authorization invalidation and bounded custody-only resumption; under T-010, disconnected inference must still be cancelled. Assess repeated 1012 behavior for restart-load amplification without assuming unshown deployment controls. Replay omits 13 reviewed units, including the integration-test and framework-parser source needed to verify those analyses directly. These unresolved implementation and lifecycle contracts require deeper review, not findings based on missing evidence.
